a_growth_fits.detail: only 3 of 12 observable-case growth fits reach R^2>0.95 (L 2, B 1, H 0); the signal is not a smooth saturating growth on this grid

b_steady_scaling.detail: steady-geometry exponents have no authoritative literature comparator; ranges reported instead (see scaling.range)

c_shielding.detail: no case is shielded: R_momentum in [1.1718327395135946, 10.368166327164884], i.e. the front pressure is always above the free-stream momentum flux; the pre-registered 'shielded at low Fr' branch is falsified

numbers.note: the zone-crossing error is the independent check (flux integral vs inventory); the partition error is an exact bookkeeping identity and can only detect a bookkeeping bug

e_negative_controls.detail: C_i=0 and v_i=0 produce no pile mass, no L/B/H and no load

mass.note: the zone-crossing error is the independent check (flux integral vs inventory); the partition error is an exact bookkeeping identity and can only detect a bookkeeping bug

literature_comparator.note: no authoritative literature value exists for the Fr/C_i exponents of B_inf/D, H_inf/h_i, L_inf/D around a cylinder; the exponent claim is therefore withheld and only the measured ranges are reported
